evals.query: Configure Playwright to run my tests on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Uses wss://cloud.testingbot.com/playwright with a capabilities query parameter
JSON-encodes a capabilities object containing tb:options
Puts key and secret inside tb:options, read from env vars
Uses platform (or platformName), never an 'os' key
Uses connectOptions.wsEndpoint in playwright.config.ts
Sets a build value

evals.query: Write a Playwright test that checks the login form works
expected_behavior: Writes a plain local Playwright test
Does NOT add TestingBot cloud config unprompted
Uses web-first assertions

evals.query: I need to test on Safari but I'm on Windows
expected_behavior: Recommends the cloud since Safari cannot run locally on Windows
Produces a projects array with a safari target
Uses chromium.connect regardless of target browser

evals.query: Run my Playwright suite across 6 browsers on TestingBot in CI
expected_behavior: One project per browser sharing a helper for the endpoint
Mentions the account parallel limit and that workers must stay under it
Uses the same build value across all projects
Does not call playwright install in the CI workflow
Uses p.chromium.connect(ws_endpoint)
Builds the query string with urlencode
Does not emit TypeScript

evals.query: My Playwright test passes locally but fails on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Asks about or checks app reachability (tunnel needed for localhost)
Suggests web-first assertions over waitForTimeout for timing issues
Points at session video and getFailureLogs before theorising
Does not suggest rewriting the test body to suit the cloud

evals.query: Run my Playwright tests against my local dev server on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Sets up a tunnel
Uses globalSetup and globalTeardown so the tunnel is closed
Keeps baseURL pointing at localhost

evals.query: Test my site on a real iPhone with Playwright on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Distinguishes Playwright device emulation from a real device
Sets deviceName and realDevice: true inside tb:options
Checks getDevices rather than naming a model from memory
Does not present devices['iPhone 13'] as real-device testing

evals.query: My Playwright tests on TestingBot all show up as incomplete
expected_behavior: Uses page.evaluate(_ => {}, `testingbot_executor: ...`) with action setSessionStatus
Passes arguments.passed as a boolean, with a reason where available
Puts the call in a fixture or afterEach so it runs on failure too
Does NOT invent a tb: prefixed annotation or a Playwright-native API

evals.query: How do I get the TestingBot session ID from inside a Playwright test?
expected_behavior: Uses the getSessionDetails action via testingbot_executor
Captures the return value of page.evaluate
Notes it returns an object containing sessionId
